events.title: The Sunless Citadel
events.summary: A missing party, a prisoner freed and the Hucrele rings.
paragraphs: The road began in Oakhurst and descended beneath the ravine. Erky was freed, Grim joined the company and the search reached Belak’s tree. The rings and news returned to the family waiting above.

events.title: The Forge of Fury
events.summary: The twins, the dwarf-halls and their first dragon.
paragraphs: The company freed the twins and arranged their passage out of Khundrukar before descending again. Nightscale waited at the Black Lake. The young black dragon fell.

events.title: Brindinford at the fair
events.summary: The Speaker in Dreams and the city’s liberation.
paragraphs: The market attack drew the party into the occupation of Brindinford. Shatterspike was sacrificed to cleanse Pelor’s temple, and the company freed Baron Euphemes from Ghaerleth Axom.

events.title: The Standing Stone
events.summary: A food caravan, Saithnar and the Horseman’s testimony.
paragraphs: They brought food to Ossington, questioned the dead and recovered Dyson’s research. The tower burned, Dyson escaped and the village turned against the company. The missing heart led onwards to Nightfang.

events.title: Heart of Nightfang Spire
events.summary: Gulthias, the severed heart and Grim’s family likeness.
paragraphs: Grim recognised a familiar gnome on a sarcophagus. The company fought through the undead cult and defeated Gulthias, fulfilling Grim’s promise to the elemental. Ashardalon remained alive beyond the fate of his original heart.

events.title: Deep Horizon
events.summary: Captives, the desmodu enclave and a lava diversion.
paragraphs: Helkitrin’s records connected the depths to people taken from familiar towns. The Brotherhood diverted lava to save the desmodu village during the assault.

events.title: The village survives
events.summary: The lava is diverted. Its delayed consequences lie ahead.
paragraphs: The rescue spared the village during the immediate assault. Revisionist: the altered lava flow would later bring catastrophe to Brindinford and the extinction of the desmodu during the company’s missing years.

events.title: Lord of the Iron Fortress
events.summary: Rigus, Acheron, Imperagon and Zandikar.
paragraphs: The company crossed from Rigus to Acheron, defeated Imperagon and broke his hold upon the forge. Terry gained Zandikar and its guardians.

events.title: Bastion’s investigation begins
events.summary: The Cathezar, Dydd’s bloodline, the First Tree and Rigus.
paragraphs: Bastion’s mystery was already under way before the later detours. The pursuit of Thunder, the soul crisis and the Guild of Sleep belonged to this earlier investigation. The final Bastion chapter is a return to unfinished business.

events.title: Those Who Writhe Below
events.summary: The aboleth whose influence would return as Brother Xanthar.
paragraphs: The aboleth thread reached into Grim’s memories. Revisionist: Xanthar used Grim’s lost flesh-golem book to manufacture his humanoid body; the private nightmare also exposed his plan for a false older brother.

events.title: Their eighth-level selves
events.summary: The Sleeper’s detour carries them into their earlier lives.
paragraphs: The Nightmare Grotto, Crimson Crazuk and the stolen Time Stone led into the Sleeper’s dream. The party played again as its own eighth-level selves in an earlier Brindinford.

links.label: The Sleeper and the Time Stone

events.title: Pengu escapes the candle
events.summary: Shrop snuffs the Nightmare Grotto candle · Revisionist.
paragraphs: The spirit Shrop released was Pengu. Its escape caused the loss of magic the company later faced in Icewind Dale. The northern Candle of the Dark One was a later working against that spirit.

events.title: White Plume Mountain
events.summary: Keraptis’s challenge and the sentient weapons.
paragraphs: The company followed the mountain’s challenge during the time-displaced detour. In the earlier Brindinford it also invested with Shoomma’s smithy and the Bank of Frobozz.

events.title: Twenty years beyond home
events.summary: They escape the past and overshoot their original present.
paragraphs: The return landed twenty years beyond the time the party had originally left. The world had lived those years without them; the companions had not simply aged through twenty years of ordinary travel.

events.title: Brindinford falls; the desmodu are lost
events.summary: During the missing twenty years · Revisionist.
paragraphs: The lava diversion’s delayed consequences caused the volcanic catastrophe that destroyed Brindinford. The same chain of consequences wiped out the desmodu race during the years the company missed.

events.title: Icewind Dale and Pengu
events.summary: Terry’s fourfold attunement and Blackrazor’s sacrifice.
paragraphs: Shrop’s snuffing of a Nightmare Grotto candle had released Pengu and caused the loss of magic. Grim prepared the northern working. Terry attuned to all four epic weapons, Blackrazor was sacrificed and the ritual was completed. Pengu’s fighting form fell, leaving the pulsing obsidian egg.

events.title: Magic heals; the soul famine continues
events.summary: The gods’ vision names twenty years without new souls.
paragraphs: Eldath said magic was beginning to recover after Pengu’s defeat. The gods also warned of twenty years without new souls being born: Ashardalon was still consuming unborn lives in the Bastion. The loss of magic and the soul famine had different causes.

events.title: The Maw, the Red Keep and the demon army
events.summary: The road home crosses the planes and the war around Rigus.
paragraphs: Angajuk’s passage led through the Astral Sea towards Acheron. The company encountered the Red Keep, the Reclamation and the demon army. The Red Keep remains distinct from Terry’s Zandikar.

events.title: Gravy’s road through the grotto
events.summary: A separate expedition · its early steps have no fixed shared date.
paragraphs: Brunn, Rook, Nox and Elira travelled through the fungal stronghold. A falling boat, goblins clinging to Rook and the Deliverance’s rescue carried their road towards buried Brindinford.

events.title: Xanthar’s portal
events.summary: Team Biscuit arrives without clothes or equipment.
paragraphs: Xanthar persuaded the four companions to use his route to the grotto. They arrived naked. Revisionist: the equipment scheme returned the surviving epic weapons to White Plume Mountain under his rule.

events.title: Biscuit and Gravy together
events.summary: The two companies fight giant ants in sunken Brindinford.
paragraphs: The roads joined in the ruined city. Shrop, Grim, Terry and Thunder fought beside Brunn, Rook, Nox and Elira against the coordinated ants. They reached the old barracks and pushed towards the Reality Wrinkle.

events.title: Biscuit reaches Windglum
events.summary: The Wrinkle leads onward into Pandemonium.
paragraphs: After the companies parted, Biscuit reached the Wrinkle’s storeroom in Windglum. Findula found a route to Eco and Desayeus.

events.title: The trap takes Gravy
events.summary: Still lost in Hell.
paragraphs: The portal trap in the Wrinkle was intended for Biscuit and caught Gravy instead. Brunn, Rook, Nox and Elira remain lost in Hell. The builder of this separate trap is not identified by Xanthar’s equipment theft.

events.title: Desayeus and the farewells
events.summary: The Soul Totem fragment, Findula’s letter and Ernie’s rings.
paragraphs: Thunder carried Desayeus’s fragment from the prison. Eco was dead and Findula ended the alliance. Ernie returned most of the equipment, gave four protective rings and departed. The company returned to Windglum before the crossing towards the Bastion.

events.title: The return to Bastion
events.summary: Into the Positive Energy Plane and Ashardalon’s refuge.
paragraphs: Protected by Ernie’s rings, the company fought through the Bastion’s defenders and brought Dydd’s descendant towards the dragon. This continues the investigation begun before the dream and northern detours.

events.title: The unborn souls
events.summary: Ashardalon still feeds as the company approaches.
paragraphs: Pengu’s defeat had allowed magic to recover. The dragon’s feeding still sustained the failing demon Ammet within his heart. The fate of the souls must be established by the final account.

events.title: The final reckoning
events.summary: The outcome awaits the GM’s account.
paragraphs: The company has reached the dragon. What becomes of Ashardalon, Ammet, the unborn souls and the companions awaits the GM’s final account.

places.title: Oakhurst
places.text: The Hucreles waited here for the rings and news from the buried fortress. The early road map shows the town and its route towards the ravine.

places.title: The Sunless Citadel
places.text: The company descended beneath the ravine to prisoners, factional bargains and Belak’s Gulthias Tree.

places.title: Khundrukar
places.text: Durgeddin’s ruined stronghold held the rescued twins, the Glitterhame, contested forges and Nightscale’s Black Lake.

places.title: Brindinford
places.realm: The city before and after the missing years
places.text: The party freed the first city, revisited an earlier Brindinford and later returned to its sunken ruins. Its old landmarks connect three different parts of the story.

places.title: Ossington
places.text: Food and seed brought the party here. Dyson’s explanations, Saithnar’s lore and the Horseman’s testimony led to a village battle and recovered transformation research.

places.title: Nightfang Spire
places.text: The spire held the cult, the severed heart and the likeness Grim recognised in the Hall of Tombs. The maps show the tower; its final heart chamber lies within the core.

places.title: The desmodu realm
places.text: The enclave faced assault while captives passed through the underground trade. The lava diversion saved its people then; its later consequences belong to the missing twenty years.

places.title: White Plume Mountain
places.text: The time-displaced detour led to sentient weapons and an escape from the mountain. Revisionist: Xanthar now rules there and holds Wave, Whelm and Frostrazor.

illustration.caption: Adventure cover reference, not a regional map.

places.title: Fungus Grotto
places.realm: The fungal stronghold and underground river
places.text: Gravy’s expedition passed through the fungal dark and a falling-boat escape before reaching the city where the two companies would meet.

places.title: Easthaven
places.text: Food, warmth, ghosts and a blizzard raid brought immediate work before the company reached the northern ritual’s end.

places.title: Frostblight
places.text: Gnometti’s kitchen, Terry’s fourfold attunement and the completed ritual led to Pengu’s egg and the collapse of the ice citadel.

places.title: Rigus
places.realm: Gate-town at the edge of Acheron
places.text: The first planar road, the Guild of Sleep, Thunder’s lost guildmates and the later war all crossed Rigus. Its earlier military order and later devastation belong to different visits.

places.title: Zandikar
places.text: After Imperagon’s fall, Terry gained the stronghold, its forge and six blade golems. Zandikar is distinct from the Red Keep of the Reclamation.

places.title: The Red Keep
places.text: Cuthbert’s account led here to the Cold Forge, refugees and Formacid allies. It is a separate stronghold from Terry’s Zandikar.

places.title: Windglum
places.text: The Wrinkle’s mirror led to shelter here. Findula traced Eco; the company returned from Desayeus’s prison before making the onward journey.

places.title: Desayeus’s prison
places.text: Eco’s body was the gateway. Desayeus yielded his Totem fragment, Thunder carried it out and the god remained bound.

places.title: The Bastion of Unborn Souls
places.text: An excess of life made Ernie’s rings essential. The crystal refuge held Ashardalon and the unborn souls upon which he fed.

places.title: Gravy’s last known destination
places.text: The Wrinkle’s trap caught Gravy instead of Biscuit. Brunn, Rook, Nox and Elira remain lost in Hell; no particular layer or route home is supplied.

illustration.caption: Nox, one of the four companions caught by the trap.

landmarks.title: Chatterstreet and the fair
landmarks.then: The market attack interrupted the fair. After the Baron’s liberation, food, wine, music and dancing returned to the streets.
landmarks.now: The later account follows two companies through sunken streets occupied by giant ants. It does not describe a restored fair or a surviving market community.

landmarks.title: The Temple of Pelor
landmarks.then: The occupied temple became a battlefield. Shrop’s sacrifice of Shatterspike supplied the holy relic for its cleansing, and Terry committed himself to Pelor.
landmarks.now: The city had collapsed by the company’s return. The surviving account does not establish the temple’s individual condition or the later fate of its priests.

landmarks.title: Shoomma’s smithy
landmarks.then: The smithy sheltered the company during Brindinford’s crisis. In the earlier lives of the Sleeper detour, the party left investments with Shoomma and the Bank of Frobozz.
landmarks.now: The twenty-year overshoot carried the party beyond the city’s volcanic destruction. The smithy’s survival and any bank or smithy payout remain unrecorded.

landmarks.title: The barracks
landmarks.then: The old street plan places the barracks beside the routes between West Hill and Silver Hill, within the town the company helped free.
landmarks.now: During the ant battles the joined companies reached the old barracks. Familiars scouted towards the ruined Magical District and the still-standing Reality Wrinkle.

landmarks.title: The Reality Wrinkle
landmarks.then: Those Who Hear and the shop’s extradimensional horrors were part of Brindinford’s first conspiracy. Thunder survived being swallowed during that investigation.
landmarks.now: The shop survived among the ruins. Its trap sent Gravy to Hell; Biscuit’s route led to Windglum. Xanthar’s earlier equipment deception is a separate event.

fold.returned: Twenty years beyond their original present
